description: Fetch full detail for a Grants.gov opportunity by its numeric opportunity id (the 'id' field from grants_search, e.g. '334326'). Returns description, eligibility, funding (ceiling/floor/estimated), key dates, CFDA numbers and the agency contact.

opportunityId.description: Numeric opportunity id from a grants_search result (e.g. '334326').

name: grants_get_opportunity
